content: वलिः, -ली {%f.%} (Also written बलिः, -ली) .²1 A fold or wrinkle (on the skin); बलिभिर्मुखमाक्रान्तम्. .²2 A fold of skin on the upper part of the belly (especially of females, regarded as a mark of beauty); मध्येन सा वेदिविलग्नमध्या वलित्रयं चारु बभार बाला <ls>Ku. 1. 39</ls>. .²3 The ridge of a thatched roof. .²4 A line made on the body with fragrant unguents. .²5 A handle of the Chāmara; रत्नच्छायाखचितवलिभिश्चामरैः क्लान्तहस्ताः <ls>Me. 37</ls>. .²6 Sulphur.
